newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 19.7 bln levs 3-, 6-mth T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 19.7 bln levs 3-, 6-mth T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry sold two issues of floater coupon T-bills with maturities of three and six months, yielding 46.16 and 92.12 percent to maturity under the current main interest rate, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 20.564 billion levs worth but the ministry approved bids for a total of 19.699 billion levs of T-bills.
The issues were offered with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance for Monday's auctions.
The coupons for both issues were set equal to the central bank's main interest rate, set at 14.15 percent monthly or 169.80 percent annually from Monday.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Bids received 10,266 million levs 10,298 million levs
Bids approved 10,026 million levs 9,673 million levs
